class.name: DVComponent
class.brief_description: Base control for DataViz UI Kit components with shared layout, theming, and formatting utilities.
class.description:
DVComponent centralizes the common behavior shared by all widgets in the DataViz UI Kit. It extends [Control] to provide configurable padding, margins, frames, tooltips, and value formatting, while also handling integration with [DVTheme] resources and the global [DVThemeManager]. Subclasses rely on DVComponent to queue redraws efficiently, react to theme changes, and expose consistent styling properties to the editor.
The class exposes helpers for formatting numbers, drawing framed backgrounds, and snapping geometry to pixel boundaries, making it a solid foundation for custom data visualization controls.

method.name: set_tooltip_formatter
method.description: Replaces the built-in tooltip text. The callable receives [code](series, index, value)[/code] and returns the string to show — use it for units, currency, or your own wording.

method.name: get_hover_text
method.description: The text the component would show for whatever is under the pointer, or an empty string when nothing is. Read this instead of enabling [member tooltip_enabled] if you would rather render the tooltip yourself.

method.name: apply_theme
method.description: Applies [param theme] to the component, optionally forcing a refresh even if the same theme is already active. This updates cached colors, fonts, and layout metrics derived from the theme.

method.name: get_pixel_snap
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when drawing and layout should be snapped to whole pixels to avoid sub-pixel artifacts.

method.name: set_pixel_snap
method.description: Toggles pixel snapping. Enable this when you want crisp rasterized lines; disable it for sub-pixel interpolation effects.

method.name: connect_theme_manager
method.description: Subscribes this widget to the [DVThemeManager] autoload, so it repaints when the active theme changes. Done for you when the widget enters the tree; call it if you moved a widget between trees by hand.

method.name: disconnect_theme_manager
method.description: Stops following the theme manager. The widget keeps the colours it has, so this is the way to freeze one widget's appearance while the rest of the game restyles.

method.name: get_tooltip_formatter
method.description: The callable set by [method set_tooltip_formatter], or an empty [Callable] when the built-in text is in use.

members.member: Whether the widget can take focus, which is what makes key events reach it at all. [DVChart] and [DV_Grid] turn this on for themselves; the passive widgets leave it off so they do not appear in the tab order of a game that never expected them there. While focused, the widget draws a ring in the theme's accent colour.
Duration for built-in transitions (in milliseconds). Increase for slower easing or set to 0 to disable animation.

Whether the widget keeps a selection when an item is clicked. Off by default, except on [DV_Grid], which turns it on for itself — picking rows is what a table is for. This gates only the selection: the click signals ([signal DVChart.item_clicked], [signal DV_Grid.cell_clicked]) are emitted either way.
Toggles tooltip emission when the user hovers interactive elements.
Extra space reserved outside the component’s content rectangle before it draws its background or frame.
Insets applied inside the frame that determine how much space to keep between the border and child content.
Multiplier applied to internal layout metrics so the control can scale up or down uniformly.
Number of fractional digits used when formatting numeric values in [constant VALUE_FORMAT] modes that support decimals.
Selects the numeric formatting style: decimal, integer, or compact.
Fill color used behind the component’s content when [member show_background] is enabled.
Radius (in pixels) for rounding the component’s frame and background corners.
Stroke color of the component frame when [member show_frame] is enabled.
Thickness (in pixels) of the frame outline.
Draws the themed background fill when [code]true[/code]. Disable for transparent components.
Controls whether the component automatically follows the global [DVThemeManager] theme.

signal.name: hover_exited
signal.description: Emitted when the pointer leaves the component. There was previously no way to know, so UI driven from a hover signal could never be cleared.

signal.name: data_changed
signal.description: Emitted whenever the component's data model changes and dependent visuals should refresh.

signal.name: layout_invalidated
signal.description: Emitted after layout-affecting properties change so that containers can request a new layout pass.

constants.constant: Formats values with [member format_decimals] fractional digits.
Formats values with compact suffixes such as K/M/B.
